title: serde_json 1.0.151 → 1.0.154 lockfile bump
summary: A single-file dependency bump: Cargo.lock moves serde_json from 1.0.151 to 1.0.154 and picks up a new transitive dependency, foldhash, which serde_json now pulls in alongside indexmap. No source, manifest or build configuration changes, so the workspace's own crates and their runtime behaviour are untouched; the only thing that moves is the resolved dependency graph.
